analysis.analyst: SEPA / CANSLIM / Stage Analysis / Darvas Box Framework

ACE.technical: Meets Minervini Trend Template above rising 50 and 200 SMAs. A rounded cup base 12.8% deep resolved into a 5.6% handle, establishing neckline pressure at 1269.27. Constructive price tightening with MACD positive confirms accumulation, though broader market headwinds require tight execution.
ACE.fundamental: Market leader in pick-and-carry cranes with 63% share. Q1 revenue expanded 20.5% with net profit up 22.3%. Virtually debt-free with strong 3-year average ROE of 26.6% and ROCE exceeding 31%. Margin profile remains resilient, supported by healthy domestic infrastructure capex.
ACE.risk: Failure to hold handle pivot below 1188.57 invalidates setup. Cut loss immediately if price breaches the 50-day moving average.

AEGISVOPAK.technical: Constructing an early base above rising moving averages with RSI 57. However, the pivot poke above 321.27 met immediate rejection, closing lower—a classic Livermore danger signal warning of overhead supply and false breakout risk in a fragile tape.
AEGISVOPAK.fundamental: Leading liquid terminal operator JV with Royal Vopak. Topline grew 12.4% YoY, but quarterly net profit contracted 7% YoY under heavier interest capitalization and expansion costs. Stretched valuation (P/E 120+) and modest ROCE (7.6%) fail CANSLIM standard criteria.
AEGISVOPAK.risk: Failure below support at 290.68 signals base breakdown. Livermore false breakout demands strict avoidance until base reconstitutes.

AETHER.technical: Textbook Stage 2 uptrend above 50 and 200 SMAs. A double bottom pattern is tightening against resistance near 1799.80. RSI 64 and MACD above zero line indicate constructive accumulation, though volume must expand substantially on pivot clearance.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemicals producer benefiting from long-term contract manufacturing. Q1 net profit grew 34% YoY with sales up 27.2%, reflecting solid operating leverage. Debt is manageable (interest coverage >10x), though rich P/E (95x) requires continuous earnings acceleration.
AETHER.risk: Break below swing low stop at 1670.91 violates structure. Close position quickly if specialty chemical peers experience broad selling.

AHCL.technical: Powerful momentum breakout clearing 20-day resistance and establishing new 52-week highs. Strong Darvas-box breakout above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Relative strength is exceptional, though microcap volatility demands stringent risk management.
AHCL.fundamental: API and intermediate manufacturer demonstrating explosive CANSLIM-style growth. Q1 sales rocketed 163% YoY while net profit jumped 88%. ROCE sits at 17.6% with debt-to-equity modest at 0.39. Promoter holding is stable at 52.7% with zero pledged shares.
AHCL.risk: Violation of breakout floor at 29.38 invalidates setup. Exit immediately if volatility causes a gap below trailing support.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Classic Stage 2 uptrend exhibiting double bottom base with neckline pivot at 953.70. RSI at 68 reflects strong relative strength versus the broader market. Price rides comfortably above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: Dominant manufacturer of water-soluble films and green packaging. Q1 sales doubled (+111% YoY) with net profit surging 151% to ₹27.4 Cr. Balance sheet is virtually debt-free with superior ROCE (29.6%) and promoter holding increasing 82 bps to 65.65%.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Failure to hold 856.75 stop terminates double bottom base integrity. Cut exposure if packaging volumes deteriorate.

ARTEMISMED.technical: Double bottom consolidation tightening below 379.18 pivot. Accumulation confirmed by 1.57x volume expansion on up-days, with price aligned above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI 61 shows steady underlying momentum without overbought extension.
ARTEMISMED.fundamental: Healthcare services provider delivering steady profitability. Q1 net profit expanded 45% YoY to ₹31 Cr on 12.9% revenue growth. ROCE is solid at 14.5%, supported by improving bed occupancy and higher ARPOB, with manageable leverage.
ARTEMISMED.risk: Breach of 344.61 swing support invalidates pivot thesis. Execute Minervini stop discipline immediately if price falters.
